title: The gunship that fired at UFOs: "cold orbs", a 105mm cannon and a recorder that "inexplicably failed"
parts:
A US gunship fired its 105mm cannon at two UFOs.
Then its video recorder "inexplicably failed".
Someone filmed the screen with a phone 📱
The Pentagon just released it all 🧵
1/ Gulf of Oman, 8 Sep 2021. An AC-130 drops a flare in the sea for target practice. On infrared: two "cold orbs", ~4 ft wide, hovering 0-20 ft over the water above the flare. For 15 seconds.
2/ The officer pulls the trigger on the 105mm. The report: in the split second before the recoil, the orbs "rapidly fly away from the flare and out of the sensor feed without changing altitude".

3/ ~25 sightings that night. Two orbs weaving "around, over, and under each other in a manner similar to how dolphins playfully swim in a pod". The source's comment: "They knew they were flying together."

4/ Clocked at 250 to 1,300 mph. Then the plane's recorder "inexplicably failed and the video data became corrupted". What survived: 6 clips shot off the cockpit screen with a phone. In one, two orbs cross the screen in 0.3 s.

5/ The science: "cold" in infrared just means colder than what's behind it. Over a warm night sea, a shiny surface reflecting the cold sky reads cold. And speeds from a circling plane's targeting tool hit the same parallax trap as GoFast. Still unresolved.

6/ See it yourself, free:
• realufo.org/archive → search "gunship" → Video
• DOW-UAP-PR121 at 0:14: press , and . to catch the pair
• read the crew's report in full: DOW-UAP-D101

evidence.label: The crew's intelligence report
evidence.evidence: "two approximately four-foot diameter cold orbs between 0 to 20 feet above the surface of the water stationary over the flare for approximately 15 seconds." "the CSO pulled the trigger firing the aircraft's 105mm cannon … the CSO observed the pair of UAPs rapidly fly away from the flare and out of the sensor feed without changing altitude." "similar to how dolphins playfully swim in a pod (SOURCE COMMENT: They [the UAPs] knew they were flying together)." "the aircraft's Digital Video Recorder (DVR) inexplicably failed and the video data became corrupted." Speeds 250-1,300 mph (p.2; OCR of the scan, lightly cleaned).

evidence.label: Two orbs cross the whole screen in about 0.3 seconds
evidence.evidence: Between 0:14.1 and 0:14.3 two dark blobs streak across the top right as a pair, smeared by their speed. At normal playback you barely see them; step frame by frame. Single orbs are clearest at 0:02.5 and 0:27.5.

evidence.label: A "cold orb" near the crosshair
evidence.evidence: A small dark orb sits just off the reticle. AARO: "secondary capture, recorded via a cellular device, of an infrared sensor display aboard a U.S. Special Operations Forces AC-130J Gunship"; expect blur, flicker and tilt.

evidence.label: What a phone filming a cockpit screen looks like
evidence.evidence: Tilted reticle, glare, screen-door noise: the footage that survived after the recorder failed. PR117-PR122 were all captured the same night.
